plain_english_policy: This bill authorizes the Alabama Legislature to allocate money from the Public School Fund specifically for local school districts' operating expenses during fiscal year 2011. It also permits those same local boards of education to spend that allocated funding on any type of operating expense they choose, provided it falls within that specific one-year timeframe.
policy_direction_if_enacted: Enactment would enable the state legislature to distribute public school funds for operational costs in fiscal year 2011 and grant local boards temporary flexibility (limited to FY 2011) to utilize those funds across various operating needs without being restricted by other existing laws.
sponsorship_supports_position: Representative Lindsey advanced this bill as an appropriations measure focused on funding public school operations for a specific fiscal year.
evidence_quotes: "To allow the Legislature to appropriate Public School Funds to local boards of education in the Education Trust Fund Appropriations Act for fiscal year 2011 for the purpose of paying operating expenses; and to allow local boards of education, during fiscal year 2011 only, to expend Public School Funds on any operating expenses."

"Section 1. Notwithstanding any other law to the contrary, the Legislature may appropriate funds from the Public School Fund to local boards of education in the Education Trust Fund Appropriations Act for fiscal year 2011 for the purpose of paying operating expenses."
